description: What sort of thing a problem statement is: a belief people hold, a capability that is missing, a condition of the world, a consequence that follows, or a shift already underway.
name: problem-kind

terms.description: A belief people hold, e.g. that democracy means voting.
terms.label: Belief

terms.description: A capability that is missing or undeveloped.
terms.label: Capability

terms.description: A condition of the world, not an experience anyone has directly.
terms.label: Condition

terms.description: A consequence that follows from some other condition or belief.
terms.label: Consequence

terms.description: A shift already underway that changes the terrain.
terms.label: Shift
